issues.detail: The Greek 'μετα του πνευματος' (with the Spirit) is translated as 'ở với tâm linh' (in/at the spirit). In this context, 'μετα' indicates accompaniment ('with'), not location.
The phrase 'προς γαλατας εγραφη απο ρωμης' (written to the Galatians from Rome) is entirely omitted from the Vietnamese translation.
